title: Add CookbookCore meal-plan parser and mutation coverage
description: Expand CookbookCore tests to cover free-text parsing, empty-line dropping, serialisation fixed points, and `removeItem(at:)` semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover parsing free-text lines into `.text` while preserving section names.
Tests cover dropping blank lines from section items.
Tests cover serialising and reparsing `.text` items and a real fixture fixed point.
Tests cover item deletion, empty-section preservation, and out-of-bounds no-op behaviour.

handoff_summary.completed: All acceptance criteria met. Five new @Test methods added to the existing MealPlanParser suite: freeTextLineBecomesTextItem, blankLinesAreDroppedFromSectionItems, textItemRoundTripsThroughSerialise, removeItemDeletesItemAtPosition, removeItemPreservesEmptySectionAfterLastItemRemoved, removeItemIsNoOpForOutOfBoundsIndex. The real-fixture fixed point was already covered by the pre-existing fixtureRoundTripsThroughSerialise test.
handoff_summary.remaining: Test execution must be performed by the tester agent. No source model or parser changes were needed — the MealPlan model and MealPlanParser were already fully implemented by dependency beads B-35b69af1 and B-f5403aed.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Tests are additive-only; no production code was modified. The SourceKit 'No such module Testing' warning is a known false positive for test targets and does not affect compilation.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to run swift test on CookbookCore and confirm all 12 tests (7 existing + 5 new) pass.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No production code changed. Test file is the sole output. No conflict risk for downstream agents working in other files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used the existing Swift Testing (@Test / #expect / Issue.record) convention already established in the suite rather than XCTest. The removeItemIsNoOpForOutOfBoundsIndex test exercises all three guard clauses (block, section, position) in a single test to keep the suite compact.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Covers all four acceptance criteria. The fixture fixed-point criterion was already satisfied by the pre-existing fixtureRoundTripsThroughSerialise test; textItemRoundTripsThroughSerialise adds specific coverage for .text items in the cycle.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: No inline-string fixture for the 'real fixture fixed point' was added because fixtureRoundTripsThroughSerialise already exercises the Fixtures/meal-plan.menu file loaded via Bundle.module.

conflict_risks: No production code changed. Test file is the sole output. No conflict risk for downstream agents working in other files.

execution_history.summary: Added 5 new tests to MealPlanParserTests.swift covering all four acceptance criteria: free-text parsing into `.text` with section-name preservation, blank-line dropping, `.text` serialise/reparse round-trip, and `removeItem(at:)` with deletion, empty-section preservation, and out-of-bounds no-op semantics. Package builds cleanly.
